items.title: Why India’s Stock Markets Hold a Session on Diwali: Explainer
items.content: India’s stock markets will open for a special shortened session on Sunday as the country celebrates Diwali, its biggest festival, keeping alive a tradition that has survived the shift from handwritten ledgers and bustling trading floors to smartphones and algorithms.
items.contentSnippet: India’s stock markets will open for a special shortened session on Sunday as the country celebrates Diwali, its biggest festival, keeping alive a tradition that has survived the shift from handwritten ledgers and bustling trading floors to smartphones and algorithms.
items.creator: Samie Modak

summaries.zh: 印度股市将在周日为庆祝最大节日——排灯节而开市进行特殊缩短交易。这一传统虽历经从手写账簿到智能手机和算法的演变，仍得以保留。
summaries.en: India’s stock markets will hold a special shortened session on Sunday during Diwali, the country’s biggest festival. This tradition, which dates back to handwritten ledgers and physical trading floors, continues despite the modernization of markets using smartphones and algorithms. The session maintains a long-standing custom of observing the festival while allowing trading to proceed.

items.title: China Extends Gold-Buying Streak to Two Years as Prices Drop
items.content: China’s central bank added to its gold reserves in October — extending a buying streak to two years — as the precious metal fell almost 7% to end the month below the $4,000-an-ounce support threshold.
items.contentSnippet: China’s central bank added to its gold reserves in October — extending a buying streak to two years — as the precious metal fell almost 7% to end the month below the $4,000-an-ounce support threshold.
items.creator: Yihui Xie

summaries.zh: 中国央行10月份继续增持黄金储备，延续了两年多的购买势头。当月黄金价格下跌近7%，收于每盎司4000美元以下的支持位下方。
summaries.en: China’s central bank increased its gold reserves in October, continuing a two-year buying streak. This occurred as gold prices fell nearly 7% for the month, dropping below the $4,000-an-ounce support level. The central bank’s actions reflect ongoing support for gold amid declining market values.

items.title: Beijing Vows to Hit Back Against US Sanctions on China Companies
items.content: China strongly opposes US sanctions on two Chinese companies over their dealings with a third party and reserves the right to take “necessary measures” to protect its interests, China’s Ministry of Commerce said on Saturday.
items.contentSnippet: China strongly opposes US sanctions on two Chinese companies over their dealings with a third party and reserves the right to take “necessary measures” to protect its interests, China’s Ministry of Commerce said on Saturday.
items.creator: Bloomberg News

summaries.zh: 中国商务部表示，强烈反对美国对两家中国公司实施制裁，并保留采取“必要措施”以保护自身利益的权力。北京方面强调，此举针对该公司与第三方交易，将坚决反击。
summaries.en: China's Ministry of Commerce has stated its strong opposition to US sanctions against two Chinese companies involved in transactions with a third party. Beijing reserves the right to take "necessary measures" to safeguard its interests in response to the sanctions. The statement reflects China's position on the issue.

items.title: How a Bank Scandal Is Taking Down Trump’s Ally in Paraguay
items.content: Officials at the Inter-American Development Bank’s investment arm suspected something was off almost as soon as they walked through the doors of Paraguay’s Ueno Bank SA.
items.contentSnippet: Officials at the Inter-American Development Bank’s investment arm suspected something was off almost as soon as they walked through the doors of Paraguay’s Ueno Bank SA.
items.creator: Manuela Tobias and Ignacio Olivera Doll

summaries.en: A scandal at Paraguay's Ueno Bank SA has led to the downfall of a Trump ally, as officials at the Inter-American Development Bank's investment arm grew suspicious shortly after entering the bank. The situation highlights growing concerns about financial irregularities and potential corruption within the institution.

items.title: The Corner Store Brings Its New York Experience to the Las Vegas Strip
items.content: Catch Hospitality Group is opening a Las Vegas location of The Corner Store at the Cosmopolitan. Co-Founder and Partner Eugene Remm says the 150-seat restaurant will preserve the intimacy and authentic SoHo experience of its 75-seat New York original, rather than offer a Vegas-specific or watered-down version. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: Catch Hospitality Group将在拉斯维加斯的Cosmopolitan酒店开设The Corner Store分店。联合创始人兼合伙人Eugene Remm表示，这家150座餐厅将保留其纽约75座总店的内向和真实SoHo体验，而非提供拉斯维加斯特色或稀释版的版本。该信息来源于Bloomberg的报道。
summaries.en: Catch Hospitality Group is opening The Corner Store at the Cosmopolitan in Las Vegas, replicating the 150-seat restaurant's intimate, authentic SoHo experience from its New York location. Co-founder Eugene Remm emphasizes preserving the original's character rather than adapting it for Vegas. The restaurant will maintain its 75-seat New York format. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Elanco Shares Jump After Q3 Beat and Outlook Raise
items.content: Elanco Animal Health shares rose nearly 8% after the company reported third-quarter earnings above expectations and raised its full-year outlook. Jeff Simmons, Elanco’s President and CEO, called it a high-quality quarter, citing 11% reported growth and broad strength across markets and product lines. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kailey Leinz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 埃兰诺动物健康公司第三季度财报超预期，并将全年展望上调，股价上涨近8%。公司总裁兼CEO杰夫·西蒙斯称该季度表现优异，报告增长11%，各市场和产品线均表现强劲。他还将在《The Close》节目中接受罗曼尼·博斯蒂克和凯莉·莱因茨的采访。（信息来源：彭博）

CEO Jeff Simmons described the quarter as high-quality, noting 11% growth and strong performance across markets and product lines. The company highlighted broad market strength during the period. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Sweetgreen CEO Says Sales Rebound After Cyclospora-Related Traffic Drop
items.content: Sweetgreen CEO and Co-Founder Jonathan Neman says that sales momentum has improved after a summer Cyclospora outbreak—unrelated to Sweetgreen’s stores but damaging to traffic across the sector. The company reported October comparable sales growth of about 5%, following a return to flat comps in September, and saw further improvement in early November. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kailey Leinz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

The company saw a 5% comparable sales growth in October, following flat sales in September, with further improvements in early November. The outbreak, unrelated to Sweetgreen's stores, previously impacted industry traffic. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: FIGS Beats Earnings as Demand Outstrips Supply, CEO Trina Spear Says
items.content: FIGS reported third-quarter top- and bottom-line results above expectations, with revenue of $190.7 million versus an estimate of $182.8 million. The company logged a fourth consecutive quarter of at least 25% revenue growth; non-scrubwear revenue rose 35%, and international revenue also increased. CEO and co-founder Trina Spear said health care professionals are expanding their FIGS purchases beyond scrubs to items such as underscrubs, compression socks and outerwear, for work and off-duty wear. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kailey Leinz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

CEO Trina Spear noted that healthcare professionals are expanding their purchases beyond scrubs to items like underscrubs, compression socks, and outerwear for both work and off-duty wear. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Braskem Owners Pull Funding Offer as Debt Talks Hit Snag
items.content: Talks between Brazil’s Braskem SA and its creditors regarding an out-of-court debt rework have soured, with shareholders taking a proposed capital injection key to a deal off the table if talks stand as they are, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.contentSnippet: Talks between Brazil’s Braskem SA and its creditors regarding an out-of-court debt rework have soured, with shareholders taking a proposed capital injection key to a deal off the table if talks stand as they are, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.creator: Mariana Durao and Giovanna Bellotti Azevedo

summaries.zh: 巴西石化公司（Braskem SA）与其债权人的庭外债务重组谈判陷入僵局，股东已撤回一项关键的资本注入提议。知情人士透露，由于债务谈判停滞不前，该资本注入计划被取消。
summaries.en: Brazilian chemical company Braskem SA's debt restructuring talks with creditors have stalled, prompting shareholders to withdraw a proposed capital injection central to the deal. The breakdown in negotiations leaves the company's out-of-court debt rework in limbo, as discussions fail to reach an agreement.

items.title: AI-Generated Movie Heading Theaters
items.content: Artificial intelligence is moving from experimental videos to the big screen. Fable Studio CEO Edward Saatchi says a team of just 30 people spent nine months creating Gods Don’t Give Gifts, an AI-generated animated feature that still relies on human directors, writers, voice actors and artists. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss how AI changes the filmmaking process and what it means for Hollywood's traditional production model. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 人工智能正从实验性视频走向大银幕。Fable Studio首席执行官爱德华·萨奇表示，一支30人的团队用9个月时间创作了AI生成的动画电影《神不赐予礼物》，该影片仍依赖人类导演、编剧、配音演员和艺术家。他接受彭博商业周刊每日节目访谈，探讨AI如何改变电影制作流程及其对好莱坞传统模式的影响。（来源：彭博）
summaries.en: AI-generated animated film "Gods Don’t Give Gifts" is set for theatrical release. Fable Studio’s CEO Edward Saatchi explains that while AI was used in production, human directors, writers, voice actors, and artists were still involved. The 30-person team spent nine months creating the film, highlighting AI’s evolving role in filmmaking and its potential impact on Hollywood’s traditional production model. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Providing Capital to Tech Companies: Masters In Business with Ann Berry
items.content: Barry speaks with Ann Berry, founder and managing partner of Threadneedle. They discuss her path from Goldman Sachs M&A and private equity to running a hospitality services company through the pandemic. They also discuss Ann's early-stage bets on AI and deepfake detection, and surveying the expanding IPO landscape. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.content: The Canadian dollar posted its biggest weekly loss since late September after weaker-than-expected domestic employment data reinforced concerns about the outlook for the country’s economy.

items.content: Hedge funds cut bullish crude bets by the most since June as the US and Iran struck rare de-escalatory notes, positioning them to profit from the selloff after the Democratic sweep of Congress.

summaries.en: Gold prices declined as a weakening technology stock market in Asia prompted investors to sell the precious metal to offset losses in other investments. The tech sector's downturn led to broader market selling, including in gold.

items.title: Wall Street Grapples With $5.7 Trillion Rout as AI Bets Unwind
items.content: Months of unease over Wall Street’s artificial-intelligence boom erupted into a global market convulsion this week, opening a dangerous new chapter for the investment frenzy that has helped power stock prices, corporate spending and economic growth.
items.contentSnippet: Months of unease over Wall Street’s artificial-intelligence boom erupted into a global market convulsion this week, opening a dangerous new chapter for the investment frenzy that has helped power stock prices, corporate spending and economic growth.
items.creator: Justina Lee and Lu Wang

summaries.zh: 华尔街因人工智能投资热潮引发的担忧在本周爆发，导致全球市场剧烈动荡，开启了一场对股价、企业支出和经济增长的助推作用的新危机。此次市场崩盘涉及5.7万亿美元，主要源于对人工智能相关投资风险的重新评估。
summaries.en: Wall Street faced a $5.7 trillion market decline as AI-related bets soured, marking a significant downturn in the investment trend that had driven stock prices and economic growth. The unease over the AI boom culminated in a global market crisis, signaling a risky shift in the sector's influence.

items.title: Chip Stocks Climb After Rout, But AI Doubts Linger: Markets Wrap
items.content: A rebound in chipmakers propped up the stock market as dip buyers emerged despite economic data that reinforced speculation the Federal Reserve will boost rates in December.

summaries.zh: 亚洲股市开盘后大幅下跌，因美国芯片股在选举后持续走低，市场担忧民主党可能加强对人工智能行业的监管。AI股暴跌加剧了美股抛售潮，亚洲市场随之下行。
summaries.en: Asian stocks declined at the start of trading, following a sell-off in U.S. chipmakers driven by fears of stricter AI regulation. The downturn reflects growing concerns about the sector's future as Democrats consider tighter oversight. The market movement highlights the interconnectedness of global equity markets, with technology shares facing pressure amid political uncertainty.

items.title: Retail Traders Cautiously Buy Stocks After Worst Rout Since 2025
items.content: Retail traders, the stock market’s most avid dip buyers since the pandemic, were among the investors buying on Friday after US equities had their worst day since 2025. But their typical enthusiasm was nowhere to be found.

items.creator: Jessica Menton and Felice Maranz

summaries.zh: 近期美股遭遇自2025年以来最严重下跌，零售投资者周五谨慎买入。作为疫情后最积极的抄底者，他们此次买入时态度谨慎，缺乏往日热情。
summaries.en: Retail traders cautiously purchased stocks on Friday following the US equities market's worst day since 2025. Unlike their usual aggressive dip-buying behavior during the pandemic, their enthusiasm was noticeably absent.

items.title: Oil Swings as Traders Parse Iran War De-Escalation Prospects
items.content: Oil swung in a choppy session, as traders weighed progress on de-escalation in the Iran war.

summaries.zh: 石油价格在交易员评估伊朗冲突降级外交进展及达成可能支持中东能源流向的解决方案前景时出现波动。市场情绪谨慎，价格随局势变化而起伏。
summaries.en: Oil prices fluctuated as traders evaluated diplomatic progress in de-escalating the Iran conflict, seeking a resolution to support Middle Eastern energy flows. The market remained sensitive to developments, reflecting uncertainty about the outcome.
